verdict.rationale: SES receipt rules automatically act on incoming mail: they can store it in S3, publish to SNS, trigger Lambda functions, deliver to WorkMail, or send bounces. Configuration sets also publish sending events to SNS or EventBridge based on characteristics you define. A community user confirms running a Lambda on inbound email. missing for 10: automation on sending events (bounces, deliveries) requires downstream AWS services like EventBridge or Lambda rather than SES-native rule actions, and the docs shown do not cover rule conditions or ordering.
